summary: The audit checks the 63 units and 13 courses, at least 11 of them HISTORY courses (cross-listings count), each taken for 3-5 units and a letter grade: a Sources and Methods seminar, a Doing History colloquium, two 200-level colloquia, two pre-1700 courses, HISTORY 209S (the WIM course) and a capstone, with other HISTORY courses filling the rest (one HISTORY 299S may count). Honors research courses do not count toward the major. Checked by hand: the four-course concentration you set with your advisor, the 2.0 GPA in History courses, up to 10 units of petitioned courses from other departments, the honors thesis or paper-revision capstone, which add no units, and presenting a capstone project at the spring Creative Capstone Showcase. AP credit does not count.
